I ported the LRU cache to TypeScript in `src/lru.ts`, and `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases.

**Testing:** on three generated inputs of up to 1M commands, the output was byte-for-byte the same as the Python original. One of the three used a small capacity so most commands caused evictions. A run of 1M mixed commands took about 0.5 s.
